newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Russian writer Vladimir Soloukhin dies at 72.
newsitem.headline: Russian writer Vladimir Soloukhin dies at 72.

text.p: Russian pastoral poet and novelist Vladimir Soloukhin has died at the age of 72, Russian media reported on Saturday.
Acclaimed for bringing the life of the Russian countryside to generations of readers, he will be buried in his native village in rural Vladimir region, Itar-Tass news agency said.
Author of titles including "Country Lanes in Vladimir", "Letters from the Russian Museum" and "Dewdrop", Soloukhin died of cancer on Friday in a Moscow hospital, NTV television said.
